name: Send daily executive briefings from Monday.com, GoHighLevel and PandaDoc with Gemini

parameters.content:
## Send daily executive briefings from Monday.com, GoHighLevel and PandaDoc with Gemini

Every morning this workflow pulls live numbers from Monday.com (tasks), GoHighLevel (leads) and PandaDoc (proposals), asks Google Gemini to write a short executive summary with red/yellow/green status, and delivers it to Slack, Outlook email, and a Monday.com dashboard board.

### How it works
1. A Schedule trigger runs every day at 8:00 in your workflow timezone
2. The Workflow Configuration node holds all IDs, column IDs, thresholds, and your company name
3. Three HTTP Request nodes pull tasks from Monday.com, contacts from GoHighLevel, and documents from PandaDoc
4. A Code node merges the data into one dataset: task completion and overdue count, lead counts, estimated pipeline value, proposal statuses, and anomaly flags
5. Gemini writes a three-paragraph briefing with status icons and one recommended action
6. A Code node formats the report for Slack, a full HTML email, and a Monday.com item
7. The report is delivered to all three destinations in parallel

### Setup
1. Create HTTP Header Auth credentials: Monday.com (Authorization: YOUR_MONDAY_TOKEN), GoHighLevel (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GHL_TOKEN), PandaDoc (Authorization: API-Key YOUR_PANDADOC_KEY), and assign each to its HTTP Request nodes
2. Connect a Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential (scope Mail.Send) to the Send Report via Outlook node
3. Connect your Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential and a Slack OAuth2 credential
4. Fill in the Workflow Configuration node: board IDs, column IDs, GHL location ID, Slack channel ID, recipient email, and company name
5. Set your timezone in the workflow settings, run once manually, then activate

### Customization
- Change the schedule to weekly or add a second daily run
- Edit the Gemini prompt to add department-specific KPIs
- Replace Outlook with Gmail, or add a Telegram node for a phone alert
- Tune the overdue and pipeline thresholds in the configuration node

### Notes
Hot and warm lead counts read the GoHighLevel tags lead-score-hot and lead-score-warm set by the GHL Lead Scoring workflow. Estimated pipeline value is read from a contact custom field whose key contains "budget". Monday.com and GHL pulls are limited to the latest 100 records.

## 1. Schedule and configure

Runs every day at 8:00 in your workflow timezone. The Workflow Configuration node is the single place for all IDs, column IDs, thresholds, and your company name.

## 2. Pull data

Three requests run in sequence: Monday.com tasks, GoHighLevel contacts, and PandaDoc documents. Each returns the latest 100 records for the Aggregate step.

## 3. Aggregate and summarize with AI

One Code node merges all three sources and sets anomaly flags. Gemini then writes the executive summary with status icons and one recommended action.

## 4. Format and deliver

The report is formatted once, then delivered in parallel to Slack, Outlook email (full HTML), and a new item on your Monday.com dashboard board.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query ($boardId: ID!) { boards(ids: [$boardId]) { name items_page(limit: 100) { items { id name state column_values { id text } } } } }', variables: { boardId: $('Workflow Configuration').first().json.mondayTasksBoardId } }) }}

options.systemMessage: You are writing an executive briefing. Be concise, factual, and direct. Use specific numbers. Recommend clear actions. Write in professional English.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: { subject: $json.email_subject, body: { contentType: 'HTML', content: $json.email_html }, toRecipients: [{ emailAddress: { address: $json.config.outlookRecipient } }] }, saveToSentItems: true }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemName: String!, $columnValues: JSON!) { create_item(board_id: $boardId, item_name: $itemName, column_values: $columnValues, create_labels_if_missing: true) { id name } }', variables: { boardId: $json.config.mondayDashboardBoardId, itemName: $json.monday_item_name, columnValues: JSON.stringify({ [$json.config.mondayDashboardStatusColumnId]: { label: 'Delivered' }, [$json.config.mondayDashboardDateColumnId]: { date: $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }, [$json.config.mondayDashboardNotesColumnId]: $json.monday_notes }) } }) }}
